say:1:1360107001:0.text: My name is Penny, and Pearl is my family name. We've been in the pearl business for generations, handling everything from trading to buying pearls.
say:1:1360107001:0.source_cn: 珀尔是我的姓氏，我们珀尔家族世世代代都在做水纹珍珠的生...
